summary: First-time parents John and Lisa Jefferson describe ten unexpected joys since welcoming baby Lucas on September 5, 2023. These include his first smile, snuggles, neighborhood support, baby babble, milestones, a fresh outlook, playfulness, successful soothing, a stronger partnership, and unconditional love. The note presents parenthood as a source of wonder despite the sleepless nights and challenges.
one_line: John and Lisa Jefferson share ten unexpected joys of new parenthood since the birth of their son Lucas in September 2023.
key_facts: John and Lisa Jefferson are first-time parents who welcomed baby Lucas on September 5, 2023.
Lucas gave his first genuine smile on Tuesday morning, October 17, 2023, while lying in his bassinet looking at his mother; Lisa said "all the exhaustion just melted away."
John finds holding Lucas against his chest calming, calling baby snuggles a remedy that soothes the soul.
On November 3, 2023, neighbor Mrs. Garcia organized a 'Welcome Baby Lucas' block party where friends, family and even strangers brought meals, advice and congratulations.
Lucas's attempts at communication, coos and gurgles, began around late October 2023 and crack his parents up.
Lucas's first trip to the park was on September 25, 2023, and his first taste of solid foods came in March 2024.
Lisa says simple things like watching leaves flutter or dogs playing in the park captivate Lucas, leading the couple to appreciate life's smaller details.
The Jeffersons, as professionals, had left play behind until Lucas came along; silly faces and belly raspberries on the evening of November 12, 2023 acted as a stress reliever.
On a challenging night in December 2023, John calmed a fussy Lucas with a gentle sway and a soft lullaby, calling it "an achievement like no other."
Lisa admits parenthood tested their relationship, but facing challenges together, including shared diaper changes and feedings, reinforced their partnership.
The Jeffersons say the unconditional love they felt the moment Lucas was born, and the love he returns by wanting to be near them, redefines their understanding of love.
